principle: render detail follows narrative agency, never social worth

A_story_anchor.purpose: people whose choices, memory, or relationship can change Minjun
A_story_anchor.render: full identity, readable face and eye-line, authored outfit, restrained full color, scene-specific acting

B_scene_actor.purpose: recurring supporting cast or a one-scene person whose gaze or action carries story information
B_scene_actor.render: distinct silhouette and age/class signal, visible but simplified face, limited Gangnam Ink palette, no generic stock-photo polish

C_atmospheric_extra.purpose: people who establish population, scale, or social pressure without speaking or steering the scene
C_atmospheric_extra.render: two or three low-contrast value planes, scene-correct clothing and posture, no readable facial features, no pure-black cutout, no cloned crowd pose

cg_policy.wedding_rule: The wedding uses separate acting shots instead of one overloaded composite: Daeun's mother alone anchors the bride-side reaction in a dusty-rose honju hanbok; living Father anchors the groom-side reaction in a charcoal honju suit; reconnected Hyunsu appears alone one row behind only when the route permits him; and the couple-wide and close shots identify only Minjun and Daeun. Every unnamed guest remains a low-contrast faceless silhouette, and Hyunsu is never assigned an unauthored partner or child.
cg_policy.identity_exception: partner may remain a back-view B-tier role only where revealing Daeun or Jiyeon would contradict ending routing

reusable_background_policy.reason: reusable places cannot silently recast a named person or freeze a route-specific action

moral_treatment.gray: all tiers keep spatial separation; A and B faces remain readable
moral_treatment.black: C recedes first, B loses color before identity, A keeps gaze and gesture; darkness may not erase acting
moral_treatment.white: human detail and air return without halo, bloom, or higher social-status styling
